The name Shyamsunder thus embodies both the qualities of God as the source of light and as the embodiment of darkness, representing the dual nature of the divine.

The name represents the divine nature of God, who is beyond the limitations of physical form and manifestations. It is believed that by invoking the name of Shyamsunder, one can connect with the divine consciousness and find inner peace and happiness. The name also reminds us of the spiritual truth that the divine is both the source of light and the embodiment of darkness, representing the dual nature of the universe.
